markets.rules_primary: If the number of Truth Social posts by Donald Trump on Oct 1, 2026 is below 5, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
How this is resolved

The observation period begins at 12:00 AM ET on Oct 1, 2026 and ends at 11:59 PM ET on Oct 1, 2026.
The primary resolution source for this market is Roll Call.
In the event that Roll Call data is unavailable or inaccurate, alternative sources may be used at Kalshi's discretion.

Payout criteria

Truths, ReTruths, and Quote Truths are included in the total count.
Replies are included if captured by Roll Call.
"Between" is inclusive of the lower and upper bound.

Doesn’t count for payout: Posts deleted as of the Expiration Time.
markets.title: Will Donald Trump make below 5 Truth Social posts on Oct 1, 2026?

markets.rules_primary: If President Trump publicly names an AI czar after Issuance and before Oct 2, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Only reporting from President Donald J. Trump or the White House qualifies for this market, including Trump’s official Truth Social account. Reports that merely reference publications from before Issuance do not qualify unless the new publication explicitly reaffirms the truth of the topic as of its publication date. Republishing another source’s content qualifies only if hosted on the outlet’s official platform with that outlet identified as publisher.

An official announcement naming a person to serve as an AI czar qualifies. Senate nomination, confirmation, and assumption of duties are not required. A pledge to name someone later, rumors, or internal consideration without a public naming do not qualify.
markets.title: Will President Donald J. Trump or the White House name an AI czar before Oct 2, 2026?
